newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-VAN DER WESTHUIZEN HAT-TRICK SETS UP SPRINGBOKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-VAN DER WESTHUIZEN HAT-TRICK SETS UP SPRINGBOKS.

text.p: A hat-trick of tries from scrum-half Joost van der Westhuizen inspired South Africa to a convincing 37-20 win over Wales at Cardiff Arms Park on Sunday.
Van der Westhuizen was in superb form and crossed the Welsh line twice in the first half and again immediately after the interval.
Full back Andre Joubert and left wing Jacques Olivier also scored tries for the Springboks with the remainder of the points coming from the boots of Henry Honiball and Joubert.

The Welsh played with more passion than against Australia a fortnight ago but their scoring opportunites were limited to five penalties from full-back Neil Jenkins and a last-minute try from fly-half Arwel Thomas.
The result means that South Africa have now won their last six tests and all five on their tour of Argentina, France and Wales.
